data.description: Pervez Ahmed Securities Limited was incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 on June 8, 2005 as a single member company and was listed on Karachi and Lahore Stock Exchanges on June 21, 2007. The Company was primarily a brokerage house engaged in the shares brokerage and trading, consultancy services and underwriting. However, the Company has amended its memorandum of association to change its principle activity to act as consultants and advisors.
